title: Can I B̵͍͛Ȇ̶͈ͅA̴̢̙͗Ţ̸̌  Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess on the Drawback Chess site (purple UI) against human players such as WanAli4504 and 'smart purple lion'; the creator tries to beat it while drawbacks get progressively worse (thumbnail 'It Gets WORSE', glitched title).
rules: Standard chess setup and movement; kings are captured rather than checkmated (Drawback Chess convention).
Each player gets a random secret-to-opponent drawback; breaking it or having no move that obeys it loses.
Drawbacks seen on screen: Religious Dispute (if your opponent moves a bishop, you must move a bishop, or lose); Friendly Fire (you can only move to squares defended by your other pieces).
Own drawback is visible to the player; opponent's drawback is hidden until game end.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king / opponent loses to their drawback.

opponent.name: Human players on the Drawback site (e.g. WanAli4504, smart purple lion)
